methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $500K total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 12 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 18.4x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
Photonium is a Pre-Seed stage company in the Chips & Semiconductors sector founded by Jennifer Song and Adam Mhatre. The target has raised $500K to date. The comparable universe includes 3 public semiconductor companies (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers in the same sector, including Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, SambaNova Systems, Etched, and Ayar Labs.

Given the early stage and absence of revenue disclosure, only the Stage-Progression method was applicable. Using total raised ($500K) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Pre-Seed to next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $1.25M. The Peer-Median approach was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable datapoints in the narrow peer set—while 12 same-sector peers exist, none of the filtered cohorts reached the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied because the target company does not disclose revenue, making the public P/S median of 18.4x across the three semiconductor tickers inapplicable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.06M to $1.44M, centered on $1.25M. This range carries material uncertainty due to reliance on a single method and the absence of granular peer financials at the Pre-Seed stage. Revenue trajectory, technology differentiation relative to named competitors, and capital efficiency will likely drive valuation movement at the next financing round.
